svg.title: ExpressionPerformer: training on ARCHS4 versus frozen evaluation on TCGA and OSDR
svg.desc: Phase 1 trains the model self-supervised on ARCHS4 only, producing two checkpoints. Phase 2 keeps the model frozen and runs held-out TCGA and OSDR data through it for feature extraction; a fine-tuning side branch underperformed.
svg.text: Phase 1 — training: self-supervised on ARCHS4 only

g.text: mask 15% of genes, predict them — no labels used

svg.text: Phase 2 — evaluation: model frozen, weights unchanged

g.text: strong imputation and ~30× compression, weak downstream classification
